=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:26-39 (identical copy in workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The tracking-issue listing `gh api "repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues?labels=ai:orchestrator-tracking&state=open"` has no `--paginate` or `per_page`, so it returns only the first 30 issues, and step 4a's fail-closed branch does not fire on a truncated but successful read.
  WHY: With more than 30 open tracking issues, an in-flight plan named by a later issue looks idle and is edited in place while the orchestrator is working from it. All four reviewers rated this MAJOR, which is mapped to high.
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:126,139 (identical copy in workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The single-plan and bundle recommendation blocks carry a caveat only when step 4a refreshed the plan. A recommended plan that is stale but not refreshed (listing unreadable, NEEDS DECISION or in flight) gets no hand-off warning.
  WHY: The user can hand off a plan whose stale text is still on the default branch. Severity disagreement: sonnet rated it NIT, while minimax, glm and luna rated it MAJOR, so the highest (high) is used.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: A recommended plan that is stale and could not be refreshed should be flagged; the PR description's hand-off rule only covers the refreshed case, and the unreadable-listing case must report stale plans as not refreshed and keep them from being recommended unflagged.
  expected_change_site: .claude/commands/audit-plans.md single-plan block (line 126), bundle block (line 139) and step 5 candidate eligibility (line 31), plus the workflow-templates copy
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Both recommendation blocks carry only the conditional "Refreshed in <maintenance PR url>" line, step 5 line 31 still ranks all PARTIAL and NOT IMPLEMENTED plans, and step 6 line 52 permits an UNSCREENED pick, so a stale, unrefreshed plan stays eligible with no caveat.
- requirement: "Plans in flight are reported, not edited. These are plans named by an open `ai:orchestrator-tracking` issue." This needs a complete, paginated tracking-issue listing.
  expected_change_site: .claude/commands/audit-plans.md step 4a tracking-issue fetch (line 26) and step 6 listing example (line 39), both copies
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No `--paginate` or `per_page` appears in the listing call, and `tests/test_audit_plans_command.py::test_tracking_issue_listing_is_fetched_once` (lines 148-151) pins reuse but not pagination completeness.
- requirement: Contract tests for step 4a's rules.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_audit_plans_command.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: The five new tests exist, but none pin pagination because the command has none yet.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:39 (step 4a line 26; identical copy in workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The tracking-issue `gh api` listing has no `--paginate` or `per_page`, so it returns one page of 30. Step 4a's fail-closed branch fires only when the listing "cannot be read", so a truncated read does not trigger it.
  WHY: With more than 30 open tracking issues, a plan named only by issue 31 or later looks idle and is edited in place while the orchestrator works from it. The suggested fix is `gh api --paginate "...&per_page=100"`, treating a listing not read to its last page as unreadable.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Step 10 tells the user to merge the maintenance PR before hand-off when the recommended plan was refreshed. The fail-closed rules mean a recommended plan can also be STALE but not refreshed. | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  Expected change site: single-plan block (line 126) and bundle block (line 139) of .claude/commands/audit-plans.md, and the workflow-templates copy.
  Evidence of absence: Both blocks carry only the conditional "Refreshed in <maintenance PR url> ..." line, so nothing warns that a stale, unrefreshed recommended plan still holds stale text on the default branch.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Contract tests for step 4a's rules. | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  Expected change site: tests/test_audit_plans_command.py
  Evidence of absence: The five new tests exist and cover the step order, the comparisons, the refresh rule, the single fetch and the step 9 wiring. They do not pin pagination, because the command has none yet.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: paginate the tracking-issue listing in both copies of line 39 (`--paginate` with `per_page=100`) and count an incomplete listing as unreadable; about 2 lines changed. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:39 (also step 4a lines 19-33; identical copy in workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `gh api` tracking-issue call has no `--paginate` or `per_page=100`, and GitHub returns 30 items per page by default.
  WHY: With more than 30 tracking issues, a truncated successful listing is treated as complete, so an in-flight plan is classified STALE and edited in place. The fail-closed branch never fires. Commit fa2126f deferred the fix for sandbox reasons, and `test_tracking_issue_listing_is_fetched_once` checks only reuse.
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:126,139 (identical copy in workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Both recommendation blocks carry a "Refreshed in <maintenance PR url> ..." line only on the success path, with no caveat for a STALE plan that step 4a could not refresh (listing unreadable, or stale but in flight).
  WHY: The Hand off lines are emitted without any warning that the default branch still holds stale text. Commit fa2126f deferred this fix for the same sandbox reason.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md and workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md: step 4a line 26; step 6 line 39 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The tracking-issue listing is described without pagination or a page size, so it reads only the first page of open `ai:orchestrator-tracking` issues.
  WHY: With more than 30 such issues open, a plan named by a later issue is absent from the listing, and step 4a may edit a plan the orchestrator is using.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: The PR description says `/audit-plans` refreshes stale plans before recommending one. When the tracking-issue listing is unreadable, step 4a must not refresh plans and must report stale plans as not refreshed. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Expected change site: `.claude/commands/audit-plans.md` and `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md`, candidate eligibility in step 5 and the recommendation output.
  Evidence of absence: Step 4a line 26 specifies no refresh when the listing is unreadable. Step 5 line 31 still ranks all PARTIAL and NOT IMPLEMENTED plans, and step 6 line 52 permits an UNSCREENED pick. The caveat at lines 126 and 139 covers only refreshed plans, so a stale, unrefreshed plan remains eligible for recommendation.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:39 (step 4a bullet at line 26; copy in workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md lines 26 and 39) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The tracking-issue listing has no `--paginate` or `per_page`, so it returns only the first 30 items. A truncated successful response is indistinguishable from a complete one, so step 4a's fail-closed rule does not fire.
  WHY: With more than 30 open tracking issues, a plan named by a later issue is classified as not in flight and is edited in place while the orchestrator plans from it. The previous editor pass (iss_618c1072ea857afc) deferred this for sandbox reasons.
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:126,139 (identical copy in workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The staleness caveat in the hand-off block applies only if step 4a refreshed the plan. On the fail-closed or NEEDS DECISION path, a recommended plan can be stale with no refresh and no warning.
  WHY: The user hands the plan to `/implement-plan-claude` with no inline indicator, and the pipeline reads the stale default-branch text. The previous pass (iss_7488611bc0706b14) deferred this fix for sandbox reasons.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: PR description: "Plans in flight are reported, not edited. These are plans named by an open `ai:orchestrator-tracking` issue." | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Expected change site: .claude/commands/audit-plans.md step 4a tracking-issue fetch (line 26) and step 6 listing example (line 39), both copies
  Evidence of absence: No `--paginate` or `per_page` appears in the listing call, and `tests/test_audit_plans_command.py::test_tracking_issue_listing_is_fetched_once` (lines 148-151) pins reuse but not pagination completeness. The last run diff did not add it.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: PR description hand-off rule ("the report tells you to merge this PR before you hand the plan off") has no inverse case, so a recommended plan that is stale and could not be refreshed gets no hand-off caveat. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Expected change site: .claude/commands/audit-plans.md single-plan block (line 126) and bundle block (line 139), both copies
  Evidence of absence: Both blocks carry only the conditional "Refreshed in <maintenance PR url>" line. No diff hunk adds a staleness caveat for the not-refreshed path, and no test covers it.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
